jsonld_raw.name: MUSK AU LAIT PARFUM 100 ML (3.4 FL. OZ)
jsonld_raw.description:
MUSK AU LAIT PARFUM 100 ML (3.4 FL. OZ). Created by perfumer Dalia Izem.

Musk au Lait is built on the contrast between the purity of white musk and the enveloping softness of a milky accord. Sandalwood introduces a warm and creamy base that provides depth and harmony. Designed to integrate naturally on the skin, it reveals a delicate and comforting trail.

Woody Amber | Soft, creamy, and enveloping
